임상규 (농림부장관 to 2008-02-28) was kept as a 국무위원 without portfolio after 농림부 was abolished, to reach the quorum of the first 이명박 국무회의 on 2008-03-03 (조세일보 2008-02-29, roster/sources/agriculture/naver_123_0001938616.html). The end of that residual status was not researched. It is not a spell of this lineage, but the orchestrator may need it for a 국무위원-level panel.

장태평 start (2008-08-06) rests on wire reports of the 임명장 ceremony plus the ministry page. No 관보 notice was found in the category-19 index or in whole regular issues 2008-08-07..2008-08-29. It may sit in a 호외 or a later issue. The complete harvested corpus (checked again after GAZETTE_DONE) contains 張太平 only as a civil servant (2002-04-22, 2005-09-07, 2006-07-13) and as 국가청렴위원회 상임위원 (관보 제16354호, 2006-10-11), never as 농림수산식품부장관.

Three exits have the 이임식 one day before the successor's appointment (유정복 2011-06-01, 이개호 2019-08-30, 정황근 2023-12-28). The legal exit date was not found, so the end is set to the successor's appointment date (inferred_from_successor). The ministry page agrees for 유정복 and 이개호 but gives 2023.12.28 for 정황근.

The ministry 역대장관 page (mafra.go.kr) gives 김재수's end as 2017.06.30 and 허상만's as 2005.01.04. News places 김재수's 이임식 as 장관 on 2017-07-03, the day his successor was appointed. The build uses 2017-07-03 (medium) and 2005-01-05 (inferred).
